split_rule: hash-selected 24 from prior affinity fit48, 8 from its head validation16; no selection from new work16 or sealed29
initialization: Both retain old 93-feature affinity exactly; 3 publication metadata features start with zero weights; null final layer starts zero
features: 93 existing affinity features plus log(1+published_count)/5, published_gap/14 capped4, trusted_memory_length/16 capped1; row uses98+same3
supervision: past known output majority, >=3 matching outputs and >=.8 purity including clutter; unknown -1 excluded; no current label creates its anchor
column_target: prefer prefix dominant published ID when present among positive candidates, otherwise all same-identity candidates; BCE still same-identity
loss: Both use same sampled binary edge loss; joint adds .5 row set-CE including learned null and .5 column set-CE including zero-logit unassigned
checkpoint_rule: Minimum full head-validation binary loss for binary, minimum BCE+.5rowCE+.5colCE for joint; no scene-rollout or seed selection

offline_gate.coverage: same number of strong competing columns accepted by old affinity max-logit>=0; use score ordering without label-based threshold choice

rollout_after_offline_pass.primary: default-seed learned_joint minus frozen baseline; other modes diagnose integration; do not choose best seed or mode post hoc
rollout_after_offline_pass.data: same prior fitting8 first; no new validation or sealed test

stopping: If offline gate fails stop rollout, preserve failed experiment. No objective weights or threshold search in this stage.
limitations: Only head scene validation; upstream association used all fit64; this is not independent whole-system validation
Models change supervision, not a claim that pair MLP can solve all missing-candidate or long-gap errors
Candidate geometry and original point scores remain frozen; no input labels or future observations enter inference
pre_run_revision: Implement the already-declared oversized-column coverage guard and require nonempty evaluation denominators; no data collected or results inspected
